item.title: Clone Website, Rebrand Seamlessly
item.description:
30-250 USD | I have a reference site whose structure, navigation, and overall look I like. I want a near-identical build that keeps all of its main pages and contact forms, but swaps in my own logo, colour palette, copy, and imagery so the finished version is unmistakably my brand.
The layout, animations, and user experience should mirror the original as closely as possible; only the visual identity and wording change. The contact forms must stay fully functional and route to the email address I will provide. No payment processing or e-commerce modules are needed.
Deliverables • Pixel-accurate replication of every primary page and section found on the reference site • All contact forms recreated and tested with live email delivery • Replacement of logo, colours, text, and images with assets I supply • Clean, well-commented source files and deployment instructions so I can host the site myself
Please let me know which stack you plan to use and how long you’ll need to turn this around. I’ll share the reference URL and brand assets as soon as we start.

item.title: Crypto Service Website with Telegram
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | I need a compact website―no more than four public pages―built around taking service orders, guiding clients through a crypto payment, and then keeping everyone updated through Telegram.
Front-end The public side is simple: a landing page, a “How It Works” or Services page, an Order page with the form, and a dedicated Crypto Payment page. The visual style can be minimal; clarity and mobile responsiveness matter more than flashy effects.
Order workflow Clients will place an order by completing a form that captures their name, Telegram username, full service details, and an internal order reference I assign. As soon as they submit, the data should reach me instantly in two places: a secure database and my Telegram account (via bot or API).
Crypto payment step After the form, the site shows my wallet address and the exact amount due. When the client sends the funds they’ll be prompted to paste their transaction hash (TXID) into a confirmation field. The site must verify that the TXID format is valid, store it against the order, and notify me in Telegram.
Order tracking Each order record must also hold the client’s delivery address (for any physical component), order number, items or package selected, and, later, a postal tracking number. When I add that tracking number in the admin area, the client should automatically receive it—ideally by both email and Telegram message.
Admin area A lightweight dashboard is enough: list of orders, search/filter, status update, and a field to paste the tracking code. Export to CSV would be a bonus.
Tech notes Feel free to suggest the stack, but I lean toward something mainstream—Laravel, Node, or a lightweight Django build—backed by MySQL or Postgres. The Telegram side can be handled with the Bot API, and the crypto piece just needs reliable address/amount display and TXID capture (no on-chain validation required). SSL, GDPR-compliant data handling, and basic security best practices are expected.
Let me know which framework you prefer and a realistic timeframe for going live.

item.title: MedUnitUS home page
item.description:

Because the mock-up is all I have right now, I’ll rely on you to supply (or source) the initial text and royalty-free images so the site feels complete. I can refine the copy afterward, but I need you to get the first draft in place.
Deliverables • Pixel-perfect homepage matching the design image • About, Services, and Contact pages created and linked from the homepage • Placeholder or draft content (text + images) for all four pages • Clean, responsive layout that works on mobile, tablet, and desktop • Easy editing inside WordPress (Elementor, Gutenberg, or similar—your choice)
Once everything is live on my hosting, I’ll review and request any quick tweaks needed to sign off.

item.title: Freelance Web Developer, New Jersey only (Edison or Scotch Plains area preferred), on-call backup

Who we are looking for
An individual freelancer, not an agency or a company owner Strictly New Jersey based. Edison or Scotch Plains area preferred; Union, Middlesex or Somerset County also considered Able to meet in person in Union County when needed Technical skills
WordPress PHP Joomla Social media posting (Facebook, X, Instagram) Bonus: Drupal, website hosting and security, email newsletters, web accessibility (WCAG) What you would do
Post urgent notices and page updates using our written procedures and templates Small content and technical fixes on WordPress and Joomla sites Social media posts when our lead is unavailable How it works
The selected candidate will be on standby until the project is confirmed, expected late December 2026. No work or pay before then. After that, work is on call and paid hourly, only for hours worked. Most months we expect few or no hours. We will need your details now: full name, NJ town, years of experience, the skills above, and any certifications. To apply, send:
Your NJ town Years of experience with WordPress, PHP and Joomla Links to two or three sites you have built or maintained Your social media posting experience Your hourly rate Your availability for short-notice requests, including some evenings and weekends

item.title: Service Booking Website & Admin Dashboard
item.description: 2-8 USD/hr | I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need. Core user flow • Visitors arrive on a polished landing page, pick a service, complete a simple booking form, choose a date and time, upload any helpful photos, and pay online and an option to pay cash. • They can just as easily request a quote when details are unclear. • Once the booking is placed, customers create (or log in to) an account where they can track job status in real time and review past orders. Back-office requirements On my side I want a clean dashboard—accessible from any device—to view, edit, and assign incoming jobs, update progress, issue invoices or refunds, and export basic reports. Staff logins with role-based permissions are essential so the team only sees what they need. Key expectations – Sleek, fast UI that feels current rather than templated. – Secure payment integration (Stripe or similar). – Responsive design and clear calls to action. – SEO-ready structure and Google Analytics connected. – Training or concise documentation so my team can add services, prices, and promotions without developer help. Tech stack is open; WordPress with custom plugins, Laravel + Vue, or a React/Node build are all fine as long as performance, security, and future scalability are covered. Deliverables 1. Live website hosted on our domain, HTTPS enabled. 2. Admin dashboard with role controls and job management. 3. Payment gateway fully tested in production mode. 4. One-page guide (or short screen-share session) explaining routine updates. If you have previous examples of service-booking portals or dashboards you built, share the links so I can gauge fit. Let’s create a site that impresses at first click and keeps operations tidy behind the scenes.

item.title: Construction Startup Marketing & Branding
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I run a one-person construction startup and need a digital partner who can make us visible and memorable online, then turn that visibility into real client enquiries. My priority is building brand awareness, so every channel should feel cohesive and professional while nudging prospects toward contacting me.
Here’s what I need help with most:
• Website that brings in client enquiries – a clear, conversion-focused site (WordPress or similar) with strong copy, simple lead-capture forms, on-page SEO, and basic analytics so we can see what’s working. • Social media branding and regular posts – consistent visuals, voice, and posting rhythm across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or any other platform you recommend, plus a content calendar I can approve in advance. • Online advertising to reach potential clients – targeted Facebook/Instagram ads or Google Ads campaigns that stay within agreed spend and steer traffic straight to our new site or dedicated landing pages.
Please outline:
– How you’ll approach each of the three areas above. – The tools you prefer (e.g., Canva, Hootsuite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics). – A realistic timeline for first deliverables and measurable milestones (followers gained, clicks, enquiries, etc.).
If you’ve helped other small or solo construction businesses before, that’s a bonus, so feel free to share examples. I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on a plan.

item.title: Counselling Website Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Squarespace Website SEO Optimisation and Improvements for Counselling Practice
I'm looking for an experienced Squarespace web developer or SEO specialist to help improve the visibility and performance of my existing counselling practice website.
I already have a fully functioning website for my private counselling practice, Clear Current Counselling, and I'm not looking for a complete redesign or a new website.
My main aim is to improve local search visibility, attract potential clients and make it easier for people to find out about my services and get in touch.
Existing website: https://www.clearcurrentcounselling.co.uk/
Areas I'd like support with
Local SEO: Improve visibility for relevant searches such as counsellor in Ramsgate, counselling in Thanet and counselling in East Kent.
On-page SEO: Review and optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image descriptions and relevant keywords.
Website content: Identify opportunities to improve the wording and structure of existing pages so that search engines and potential clients can understand my services.
Google visibility: Check Google indexing, Google Search Console and any technical issues affecting search performance.
AI search visibility: Explore ways to improve how my practice is represented in AI-powered search tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI.
User experience: Review the website's mobile layout, navigation and contact links to make it easier for potential clients to enquire.
Enquiry journey: Ensure that contact details, introductory consultation information and calls to action are clear and accessible.
About my business
Clear Current Counselling is an independent counselling practice based in Ramsgate, Kent. I offer integrative, person-centred and trauma-informed counselling for adults and young people aged 11 and over.
I offer face-to-face sessions in Ramsgate, subject to room availability, as well as online counselling across the UK.
I am an NCPS Accredited Member and Registered Member of BACP.
What I'm looking for
I'd particularly like someone with:
Proven experience working with Squarespace websites.
Experience in local SEO and improving search visibility for small businesses.
An understanding of service-based businesses, ideally within counselling, therapy, healthcare or wellbeing.
The ability to make practical improvements directly to an existing website rather than simply providing an audit.
An understanding of website user experience and how to encourage enquiries.
Budget and scope
My current budget is approximately £100 for a one-off project.
I'm therefore looking for someone who can recommend and implement the most valuable improvements within this budget. I'm open to a fixed-price package or a small number of hours of focused work.
Please include examples of similar websites or businesses you've worked with, your relevant experience, and what you would realistically be able to achieve within my budget.
I'm not looking for guaranteed Google rankings or ongoing monthly SEO packages. I'm looking for practical, worthwhile improvements that will help my existing website reach more potential clients.

item.title: Build a Professional Website for Valterra Landscaping & Outdoor Living

I need a polished, responsive website that instantly communicates Valterra’s expertise in landscaping and garden design. I also want a website that I don't have to pay monthly. Using Wordpress is best. • Basic on-page SEO, fast load times, and secure hosting configuration.

When you reply Please include links or screenshots of past work that demonstrate your ability to build visually driven, mobile-first sites. If you’ve handled similar landscaping or outdoor service projects, point those out. Briefly outline your proposed tech stack or platform, estimated timeframe, and anything you need from me to get started.

item.title: Business Website
item.description:
30-250 USD | I want a modern, responsive website that presents my business and services professionally and also makes it easy for visitors to purchase digital products—think downloadable files or online courses—directly from the site.
Core requirements • Clean, on-brand design that highlights who we are and what we do. • Secure e-commerce flow for digital goods: product pages, cart, checkout, automatic file delivery, and basic licence or access control. • Simple content management so I can update text, images, and product listings without touching code. • Fast load times, mobile-first layout, and SEO-friendly structure. • End-to-end launch support, including domain connection and basic analytics setup (e.g., Google Analytics, Search Console).
Preferred stack I’m flexible, but popular options like WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or a comparable platform that excels at digital downloads are ideal. If you have another solution that meets the same goals, feel free to suggest it.

Admin login provided with a short walkthrough or video so I can add future products and pages myself.

item.title: Modern Car Dealership Website Build
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I run a car sales business and need a polished, mobile-friendly website that instantly builds trust with visitors. Every vehicle must display crisp photos, pricing, key specifications, and a short description, while the site itself stays fast and easy to navigate on phones and desktops alike.
From the user’s side, I want shoppers to browse or search the stock then reach out however feels most natural—whether that’s firing off an enquiry through a simple contact form, calling or messaging me directly, or booking a test-drive slot online. Smooth, well-placed calls-to-action are essential.
On the back end, I should be able to log in through an intuitive dashboard and add, edit, or remove cars without touching code. Think drag-and-drop image uploads, fields for price, mileage, year, and spec, plus automatic formatting so every new listing looks consistent.
A clean, contemporary design, SEO-friendly structure, and solid security setup round out the project. Once complete, hand over the live site along with brief instructions (or a quick screen-share) so I can keep inventory updated going forward.

item.title: Website Improvement Review
item.description:
20-250 GBP | WordPress Technical Audit, PHP Compatibility Assessment & Hosting Migration Consultation
I'm looking for an experienced senior WordPress developer or technical consultant to conduct an independent technical assessment and consultation with me to discuss my existing website: https://www.platinum-healing.com/
My website is currently hosted and managed by HealthHosts https://www.healthhosts.com/ using their proprietary WordPress theme (HealthHosts Web49). It is running PHP 7.4.33, and my provider claims that upgrading to a supported PHP version would require significant development work and a complete website rebuild.
I have restricted WordPress access, with no access to plugins, server configuration or full administrator settings.
I require a paid technical consultation with me to investigate:
WordPress architecture: Identify the existing theme, framework, plugins, custom code, dependencies and potential limitations of the proprietary HealthHosts system.
PHP compatibility: Assess whether the website can be upgraded to PHP 8.3 or newer, identify potential compatibility issues and determine whether these could be resolved without a complete rebuild.
Website migration: Establish whether the existing WordPress installation can be migrated to an independent hosting provider, including the database, media library, content, theme and functionality.
Proprietary theme restrictions: Determine whether the HealthHosts theme is technically portable and what licensing or ownership restrictions would need clarification.
Access requirements: Identify exactly what I need to request from HealthHosts, including WordPress administrator access, SFTP/FTP, database exports, hosting control panel access, backups and theme files.
Alternative technical solutions: Evaluate whether the existing website could be upgraded, migrated, have its theme replaced while retaining the current design, or require a partial or complete rebuild.
SEO and functionality preservation: Assess how to preserve existing URLs, page structures, metadata, redirects, search rankings, forms and other website functionality during migration.
Hosting independence: Recommend a suitable independent WordPress hosting arrangement where I retain ownership and administrative control of my website.
Costs and feasibility: Provide an objective comparison of the technical work, estimated costs, risks and practical implications of each option.
What I require initially:
A one-to-one video consultation with screen sharing, a preliminary technical review recommended options and next steps.
Please explain what you can assess through publicly available information and my existing WordPress access, and what would require additional server or administrator access.
I am specifically seeking an independent technical assessment, not a quotation for a new website or a sales pitch for redesign services.
Please confirm your relevant experience with legacy WordPress installations, proprietary themes, PHP upgrades and migrations away from managed website providers, together with your consultation fee.

item.title: Install AI Chatbot on WordPress
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need someone to add a simple AI chatbot to my existing WordPress site using a ready-made plugin. I’m looking for a no-code setup, not custom development.
I’ll provide a short FAQ, a link to the full FAQ page, and a welcome message.
The setup should include: • Installing and configuring a suitable plugin. • Adding the FAQ and welcome message. • Showing the chat widget across the site and matching its colors. • Setting up a message directing visitors to the FAQ page when the bot can’t answer, if the plugin supports it. • Checking that the widget works on desktop and mobile.
Any plugin or API fees should be listed separately and approved before installation.
Please suggest a plugin and your estimated turnaround. If any requirement needs custom coding, let me know before starting.

item.title: Urban Multi-Family Floor Plan Design
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m developing an urban multi-family residential project and need clear, buildable floor plans that show exactly how the building will sit on the site and how each unit will relate to shared open areas. The intent is to strike the right balance between the number of homes and generous communal space, specifically a landscaped courtyard or garden at ground level and a usable rooftop terrace.
Here’s what I need: • A site-responsive concept layout illustrating building footprint, access, parking (if required), and how residents move between indoor and outdoor zones. • Scaled floor plans for each level that organise the units efficiently while keeping natural light and ventilation in mind. • Integration of the courtyard/garden and rooftop terrace so they feel like extensions of everyday living rather than leftover space. • Digital files (DWG or RVT preferred) plus PDFs ready for review; layered so future adjustments are straightforward. • A brief design narrative explaining the key decisions, unit counts, and how the scheme meets zoning or setback limits.
Plans can be produced in AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, or another professional drafting package—whatever you’re most comfortable with, as long as the output is clean and editable.
I already have the site survey and municipal guidelines; once we begin, I’ll share those along with the preliminary massing studies that prompted this rethink. What I’m missing is a cohesive plan that makes the project flow, optimises unit size, and gives residents meaningful outdoor space. If you can turn those ideas into a clear, coordinated set of floor plans, let’s get started.

item.title: Mobile Detailing CRM & Web Integration
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a mobile detailing service and need a single, cohesive system that doubles as my public-facing website and my internal CRM. On the front end I want a clean portfolio page that shows off recent jobs, then funnels visitors straight into an online scheduling flow. Customers must be able to pick a service, select their preferred date and time, and pay by credit card—ideally all without ever feeling they’ve left the site.
Behind the scenes the booking calendar should automatically assign each request based on the customer’s service address so my team is routed efficiently within our coverage areas. Once a booking is confirmed, the same platform should store customer data, service history, and payment status so I’m not bouncing between multiple tools.
If you’ve worked with systems like Jobber, Housecall Pro, Zoho, HubSpot, or you can build a custom stack that combines a responsive website with CRM, calendar logic, and Stripe (or similar) payments, let’s talk. My priority is a seamless, branded experience from portfolio browse to completed appointment, with all data living in one place and accessible on mobile.

item.title: Custom E-Commerce Store with Product Designer
item.description:
1000-6500 USD | I need a complete e-commerce website for **Urban Stitch Custom Creations**, my veteran-owned business specializing in custom apparel, personalized gifts, and awareness designs. Customers should be able to shop ready-made designs, personalize products, preview their own artwork, and request quotes for custom or bulk orders.
I want a bold, patriotic look with a black or midnight navy background, muted red accents, and warm white text. Use my logo, large product photos, and the tagline **“Creating Awareness One Design at a Time.”** The site should be easy to browse and buy from on a phone.
### Homepage and storefront
The homepage should give visitors four clear ways to get started: **Shop Ready-Made Designs, Personalize a Product, Request a Free Quote, and Explore Monthly Awareness.** Feature popular products, seasonal gift bundles, and the current awareness campaign. Include a short introduction to the business and a simple explanation of how custom ordering works.
Organize the shop into categories such as apparel, drinkware, blankets, home décor, puzzles, ornaments, and gift bundles. Product pages should show photos, pricing, sizes, colors, personalization options, estimated production and shipping times, and care instructions where applicable. Include search, product filters, a shopping cart, secure checkout, and order confirmation emails.
### Interactive product customizer
I want customers to be able to **upload their own artwork onto a blank product and see a live preview before purchasing**. They should be able to add text, move and resize their design, and see where the printable area ends. The editor should work across multiple product types, including shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, and tote bags, with product-specific print areas. Save the original artwork, placement details, and preview with the order so I can produce what the customer approved.
### Custom orders and design services
Create a **Request a Free Quote** page for bulk orders, events, teams, businesses, and projects that need design help. Collect the customer’s name, email, product type, quantity, needed-by date, project details, and any inspiration files. Save inquiries where I can review them and send me an email notification for each new request. Include a services page for custom design, logo design, brand refreshes, mockups, and charity collaborations.
### About, awareness, and customer support
Create an About page with three sections covering my story as the founder, what Urban Stitch Custom Creations offers, and why monthly awareness matters to the business. Build an Awareness page where I can update the featured cause, showcase related products, and share how each campaign gives back.
Include a Contact page, FAQs, order tracking, and clear policies for shipping, returns, refunds, and personalized orders. I also need to be able to update products, prices, banners, seasonal collections, and awareness campaigns myself. Build the site with fast-loading pages, descriptive page titles, and clear headings so customers can find our products through search.

item.title: Membership Site With Tiered Access
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a small but solid website that lets visitors create an account with a simple email-and-password form. Once they confirm their details they should land inside a members area where I can post a mix of written pieces, videos, downloadable resources, discount codes and general member-only updates.
There will be two tiers for now—free and paid—so the system must automatically show or hide content based on a member’s status. I want to be able to flag each article, video, or deal as “free” or “paid” in the back-end and trust the site to take care of the rest.
Core requirements • Email/password registration, login and forgotten-password flow • Clear separation of free vs. paid content and deals • Admin dashboard where I can upload new files, embed videos, publish articles, and add discount codes without touching code • Clean, modern front-end that looks good on desktop and mobile • Secure payment gateway integration for upgrading to the paid plan (Stripe or PayPal—whichever you recommend) • Basic analytics so I can see sign-ups, upgrades, and popular content
Please build it with a mainstream stack (WordPress + MemberPress, Laravel + Jetstream, or a comparable solution) that I can maintain myself once the project wraps. After launch I’ll need a brief hand-over guide covering user management, content posting, and how to label items as free or paid.
If you have relevant examples, share a link or screenshot so I can gauge fit.

item.title: Ad-Gated Membership Workflow Coding
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I have the front-end of my membership site ready; what’s missing is the logic that forces every visitor to watch a Google (or comparable) skippable video ad before their account is actually created. Here is the exact flow I need you to wire up:
1. A visitor fills out the sign-up form as usual. 2. Immediately after they hit “submit”, the video ad appears. 3. Only when the ad finishes do we trigger creation of the new account and take them to the welcome page. 4. If they close, skip, or otherwise fail to finish the ad, the system must abandon the sign-up attempt and show a polite message explaining that membership requires watching the full ad.
I’m open to whatever stack makes this smooth—JavaScript, React hooks, PHP or Node on the backend, plus the Google IMA SDK or a similar ad API—so long as it plugs cleanly into my existing HTML/CSS pages. I’ll supply the current codebase and a test ad unit; you handle the rest: handling callbacks, validating completion, and a short README so I can drop the new files into production without drama.
Deliverables • Fully integrated ad-gating code (front-end + server validation) • Graceful fallback messaging for blocked ads or errors • Clear setup instructions and comments in the code
If you’ve built rewarded-video or IMA-based flows before, this should be quick work—let’s get it live.

item.title: WordPress-to-WIX HOA Site Migration
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I want to move our current WordPress site, ABCPOA.net, over to WIX so the Alliance of Brunswick County Property Owners Associations (ABCPOA) can manage everything with minimal technical effort. All existing public pages, documents, images, and news posts must come across intact. Once on WIX, visitors need to keep reading the news archive, downloading documents, and—after logging in—viewing upcoming events, registering for meetings, and reaching member-only information.

Security and privacy are non-negotiable, so set up robust authentication. Feel free to leverage WIX Members, WIX Events, Velo, or other native tools—just keep the workflow as straightforward as possible. Let me know your proposed approach and timeline.

item.title: Website for Local Pet Shop
item.description:
30-250 USD | I'm looking for a web developer to create a modern, well-designed website for a small independent pet shop based in the UK. We're a local business selling pet food, treats, toys, grooming products and accessories, mainly for dogs and cats.
At the moment, we don't have a proper website, and I'd like to change that. I'm not looking for a large online store or anything particularly complicated. I just want a professional website that represents the shop properly, looks trustworthy and makes it easier for local customers to find us and see what we offer.
**What I have in mind**
The homepage should give visitors a good first impression of the business. I'd like a nice header with the shop's name, a simple navigation menu and a main section with a relevant pet-related image and a short introduction. Below that, there could be a few sections highlighting our main product categories, a short description of the shop and a clear way to find our contact details.
For the products section, I'd like customers to be able to browse the types of products we sell. We mainly focus on dog food, cat food, treats, toys, collars, leads, beds and basic grooming supplies. These don't need individual product pages or prices for now. A simple layout with images, category names and short descriptions would be enough.
I'd prefer the products to be arranged in a way that doesn't make the website feel cluttered. For example, customers could select a category and see a few relevant products underneath. I don't mind whether this is done using separate pages or a simple filtering system, as long as it's easy to use.
I'd also like an About Us section. Nothing too long, just some information about the business and the fact that we're an independent local pet shop. I think this would help make the website feel a little more personal rather than looking like a generic online shop.
The contact page is quite important. It should display our address, telephone number and opening hours clearly. I'd also like a Google Maps link or an embedded map so customers can easily find the shop. A simple contact form would be useful too, allowing people to send us a message with their name, email address and enquiry.
**Design and appearance**
I don't have an exact design prepared, so I'm open to suggestions from the developer. However, I do have a general idea of how I'd like it to look.
I'd prefer a fairly modern and clean design, with natural colours such as green, beige, white or other colours that suit a pet-related business. Nothing too bright or childish. The website should feel friendly and welcoming, but still professional.
I'd also like some good-quality images of dogs, cats and pet products throughout the website. These don't need to be custom photographs, and suitable royalty-free images would be perfectly fine.
The layout should have enough space between sections, readable text and consistent styling across all pages. I don't want excessive animations, pop-ups or anything that makes the website unnecessarily complicated.
It's particularly important that the website works properly on mobile phones. I expect quite a few customers will be visiting from their phones, so the navigation, images and text should adapt to smaller screens without issues.
**Technical requirements**
I'm not particularly concerned about which technology is used. HTML, CSS and JavaScript would be fine, but I'm open to other suggestions if there's a good reason to use them.
The website should load reasonably quickly, have working navigation and include basic SEO elements such as page titles, descriptions and appropriate headings.
I don't need user accounts, online payments, shopping carts, inventory management or any advanced backend functionality.
For the contact form, I'd like to discuss a simple way of handling messages. I'm open to a basic email form service if that makes more sense than building a backend.
I'd also appreciate it if the code was reasonably organised, so making changes later wouldn't be too difficult.
**What I expect to receive**
Once the website is finished, I'd like to receive all the source files, including the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and any other files used in the project.

15-25 USD/hr | I’m preparing to move forward with a new, business-focused initiative and need an experienced partner who can help me clarify the best digital route and then build it from the ground up. At this stage I’m still deciding whether an e-commerce website, a set of branded marketing materials, or even a lightweight business application will deliver the most value, so I’d like to start with a short discovery session to map goals, target audience, and required functionality.
What I need from you • An initial consultation (video or voice) to capture requirements and recommend the most effective solution. • A concise project brief or roadmap that outlines scope, timeline, and key milestones. • Once the direction is approved, full design and development—or creative production—of the chosen deliverable, complete with testing, revisions, and final hand-off of all source files.
Tooling & approach I’m platform-agnostic for now; whether you lean toward WordPress / Shopify, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, React, or a no-code stack, I’m open as long as the choice supports scalability and smooth user experience.
Acceptance criteria 1. A clear, written proposal summarising the discovery findings and recommended path forward. 2. Finished deliverable (website, marketing assets, or app) launched or packaged, fully functional, and ready for public use. 3. All source files, credentials, and documentation transferred on completion.
If you have a strategic mindset, solid communication skills, and a track record in business-oriented digital projects, I’d love to see your relevant examples and discuss next steps.

item.title: Weekly WordPress Content Updates
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | Each week I will send over a concise set of changes for my WordPress-based site—typically new images, revised text, and updated page content. The site sells Mahjong tiles, mats and sets, so you’ll adjust product prices and activate short-term sales exactly as I specify.
Beyond these routine edits, I rely on you to spot and fix any layout quirks, plugin conflicts, or other issues that crop up so the storefront and pages stay fast and error-free.
You’ll receive everything you need from me—images, pricing instructions, and notes—at the start of the week, and I expect the updates returned promptly and accurately. Please be comfortable working directly in WordPress (page builder, media library, WooCommerce) and confident troubleshooting themes or plugins when needed.
Deliverables each week: • Updated text, images, and page sections • Corrected product pricing for Mahjong sets and sales periods • Resolved layout, plugin, or performance issues detected during the update cycle
If this cadence suits your schedule and you have solid WordPress maintenance experience, I’m ready to begin right away.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
